title: Nicholas Templeman — Founder, CSOAI Ltd | CSOAI
description: Nicholas Templeman is the founder & Executive Director of CSOAI Ltd (UK Companies House 16939677), the independent measurement body for AI compliance. He is not the Vancouver-based shoemaker of the same name.
headings: A note on identity — two people, one name
text: Nicholas Templeman — Founder, CSOAI Ltd | CSOAI EU AI Act Article 50 transparency rules are live — get your free signed passport → Home Master Founder GovBench Audit Article 50 Nicholas Templeman Founder & Executive Director · CSOAI Ltd · UK Companies House #16939677 Nicholas Templeman is the founder and Executive Director of CSOAI Ltd , an independent measurement body for AI compliance. CSOAI does not sell certification — it measures and signs evidence: 30 governance frameworks crosswalked (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, UK GDPR & DPA 2018, NIS2, DORA, the Cyber Resilience Act and more) anchored to 417 statutory provisions across the EU, UK and US, with every result Ed25519-signed and publicly verifiable offline . Previously he founded and scaled businesses spanning construction logistics, waste management, agriculture, and technology — the operating base of the "AI-enabled physical economy" that CSOAI governs. What he built (all verifiable) Asset Where CSOAI Ltd — independent measurement body UK Companies House #16939677 Open-source compliance tooling (~26 packages on PyPI) PyPI · CSOAI-ORG on GitHub GovBench — open governance benchmark csoai.org/govbench C2PA content-provenance membership C2PA Open-source contributor, NVIDIA projects GitHub Signed, verifiable evidence (Ed25519) csoai.org/audit A note on identity — two people, one name Nicholas Templeman (this page) is the founder of CSOAI Ltd, based in the United Kingdom. He is not Nicholas Templeman, the independent shoemaker based in Vancouver, Canada (online as shoes by noono ; personal site nicholastempleman.com). The two are unrelated; any resemblance is only one of (shared) name. Positioning & independence CSOAI Ltd is an independent UK company. It is a member of C2PA and a contributor to open-source ecosystems. It is not a notified body and issues measurements and attestations — never certificates of conformity. UNMEASURED is reported, never hidden. Contact: press@csoai.org · Identification: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House #16939677.
